_comment: Role mapping for the migration flow. No new contract files: every role is an existing source (workspace/plasma/contracts, workspace/justitia-1/scripts/contracts, workspace/tronmail/contracts/HorseMonkey.sol, tronmail/contracts/stack.sol).

chain.note: foundation = the user-supplied key (TF2vciEfCzK81qggZ4AUsxUsnx4JyESaLe); funded 10^12 in the node genesis, used for every deploy/call

fork_run._comment: tronmail/deploy.py - one clean run against the canonical sources (2026-11-27)

gen_asset.role: HORSE genesis foundation asset (TRC10 analogue, huge supply)

token_wrapper.role: token wrapper (TAUV analogue) - wraps the token, setter/getter via the inner contract

router.role: router (proxy router, hidden dispatch) - the migration path
router.patch: the single PUSH4 fff840d6 in the bin is patched to 1129361d - the same hidden selector the mainnet router TQMvFCNyhnCEDBeQ6fGPzLGddzaRw6cso6 answers to; no VM escape

mainnet_trigger.role: mainnet-side trigger into the mock (fires the router's busy path)

trigger_event.role: trigger event contract (TNvi/TSAC analogues) - the hook the light node watches

plasma_root.role: plasma root chain (deposit -> exit queue, +2 weeks)

plasma_child.role: plasma child chain (UTXO, JT mint 2x, depositChildChain)

validate.role: plasma signature validation library (linked into RootChain)

mainnet_reference_roles._comment: verified 2026-11-27 on api.trongrid.io. All live on MAINNET only, except the gen exchange account (TNvi) which exists on BOTH networks.

TAUV_wrapper.mainnet: EOA, 1267.0786 TRX, TRC10 holdings, no code

TQMvF_router.mainnet: CONTRACT 6548 B, ABI cleared, hidden selector 0x1129361d, transferFrom-based pull, no hardcoded owner

TNvi_gen_exchange_account.mainnet: EOA, 23474.9884 TRX, 531207.097331 USDT, ownerThr 1 self, active ops 7fff1fc0033ec30f
TNvi_gen_exchange_account.shasta: EOA, 4.000103 TRX, TRC10 1001540, same permissions, created 2026-04-24
TNvi_gen_exchange_account.note: the only role living on both networks - the fork/shasta side that bridges to mainnet

TSAC_resources_delegation.mainnet: EOA, 1176.1515 TRX, 9879.043071 USDT - the migration source

our_mainnet_accounts._comment: our funded mainnet accounts - a 2-of-2 multisig, so every transfer needs BOTH owner keys

key1.active_permission: threshold 2, ops 3f3d1ec0032001000... (TransferContract bit31 set, AccountPermissionUpdate bit11 set)

zen_issuer.balance: 0 TRX, self-owned 1-of-1, ops 7fff1fc0033e0300 - the TRC10 issuer slot

fork_foundation.balance: fork only (10^12 in the justitia genesis) - not a mainnet account

mainnet_blocker.state: the mainnet transfer is built and signed but needs the second owner signature
mainnet_blocker.evidence: tronmail/cosign.js broadcasts TRC20 USDT F(44)=701.408733 -> TYX5 and F(40)=102.334155 -> TWsbx from key1; with one signature the node answers 'Validate signature error: sig error' because key1's owner/active permissions have threshold 2
